# Description

This form provides for the reporting of morphometric measurements and biological sample information for any species caught in association with IOTC fisheries.

Click [here](./Form-5MB.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 5MB, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

# Metadata

## Submission Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `John Doe` |
| Liaison officer email	| M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1996-03-27` |
| Submission date | M | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1997-03-21` |

## General Information

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Reporting year | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer	 | `1996` | 
| Reporting entity | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](#entities) | `EUR` | 
| Flag state | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the country registration of the fishing vessels | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | `EUR.FRA` |

# Morphometric Data

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| SpecimenID | The unique identifier for the sampled fish specimen | String | `IFRFRI000142` |
| Date start | The earliest date on which the fish could have been caught (start of the sampling period) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DD] | `2025-01-01` |
| Date end | The latest date on which the fish could have been caught (end of the sampling period) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DD] | `2025-01-03` | 
| Area | The area of origin of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Areas](#areas) | `6100050` |
| Gear group | The group of fishing gears that caught the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Gear groups](#gearGroups) | `PL` |
| Species | The species of the sampled specimen | **Code** from [Species](#allSpecies) | `FRI` |
| Sex | The sex of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Sex](#sexes) | `F` |
| Status | The preservation or processing condition of the sampled fish | **Code** from [Fish status](#fishStatus) | `DEF` |
| Maturity | The reproductive stage of the fish determined by visual inspection of the gonads without a microscope | **Code** from [Maturity Stages](#maturityStages) | `DEV` |
| Measurement | The type of morphometric measurement taken | **Code** from [Measurements](#measurements) | `FL` | 
| Measurement tool | The tool used to take the morphometric measurement | **Code** from [Measurement tools](#allMeasurementTools) | `CA` | 
| Value | The morphometric measurement expressed in the appropriate standard unit, i.e., centimetres (cm) for lengths and kilogrammes (kg) for weights | Numeric with one decimal place | `35.5` |

# Sample Data

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| SampleID | Unique identifier for the sample | String | `LIV0018` | 
| Materials | The type of biological materials collected | **Code** from [Biological Materials](#biologicalMaterials) | `LI` | 
| Protocol  | The reference to the sampling protocol used | String (free entry text) | [protocols.io](https://www.protocols.io/view/c-elegans-worm-size-measurement-e6nvwke4wvmk/v1) | 
| Preservation | The type of preservation of the sample | **Code** from [preservation type](#samplePreservationMethods) | `FR80` |
| Location | The location of the sample | String (free entry text) | `Ifremer Freezer in room A5` |
